g.textArea: The Recon table: one row per spilled row list, compared with the table built beside it.

rect.data-description: INPUT (typed). Typed label: the sheet that holds the spilled row list (Sunday to Friday, Daily Supply & Demand, DoughWeights, Mix-Slice-Oven).

FORMULA (this sheet). Reads the spill address out of the Array Rows formula. In the file: =SUBSTITUTE(MID(FORMULATEXT(C5),FIND("!",FORMULATEXT(C5))+1,99),")",""), i.e. =SUBSTITUTE(MID(FORMULATEXT([@[Array Rows]]),FIND("!",FORMULATEXT([@[Array Rows]]))+1,99),")","")
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =ROWS(ANCHORARRAY(Sunday!A3)) on the Sunday row; each row points at its own sheet's spill, so Excel flags the column as inconsistent. That is expected.
INPUT (typed). Typed label: the Excel table built beside that row list (Sunday to Friday, DSD_DSnD, Dist_DSnD, DoughWeight, Mix_Slice, Oven_Info).
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =ROWS(Sunday[]) on the Sunday row; each row names its own table, so this column is not a calculated column either.
FORMULA (this sheet). In the file: =C5-E5, i.e. =[@[Array Rows]]-[@[Table Rows]]. Positive means SKUs are missing from the table.

FORMULA (this sheet). In the file: =IF(C5=E5,"Match",IF(E5>C5,"Table longer","Array longer")), i.e. =IF([@[Array Rows]]=[@[Table Rows]],"Match",IF([@[Table Rows]]>[@[Array Rows]],"Table longer","Array longer"))

rect.data-title: Adjacent Table label out of date
rect.data-description: ISSUE. Row 13 still says Mix_Slice_Oven, but the table is now Mix_Slice and Table Rows reads ROWS(Mix_Slice[]). The count is right; only the label is stale.
NOTE. It only counts rows. It would not catch the BOM double count, K4 not matching today, the stale Sunday!B1 date, the dead order grids or #N/A values inside matching tables.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Sunday, Array Cell A3#: Array Rows 395, Table Rows 395, Difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Monday, Array Cell A3#: Array Rows 395, Table Rows 395, Difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Tuesday, Array Cell A3#: Array Rows 395, Table Rows 398, Difference -3. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Wednesday, Array Cell A3#: Array Rows 395, Table Rows 447, Difference -52. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Thursday, Array Cell A3#: Array Rows 395, Table Rows 447, Difference -52. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Friday, Array Cell A3#: Array Rows 395, Table Rows 447, Difference -52. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Daily Supply & Demand, Array Cell A8#: Array Rows 275, Table Rows 275, Difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Daily Supply & Demand, Array Cell A287#: Array Rows 120, Table Rows 120, Difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Mix-Slice-Oven, Array Cell A6#: Array Rows 390, Table Rows 391, Difference -1. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sheet Mix-Slice-Oven, Array Cell A410#: Array Rows 68, Table Rows 86, Difference -18. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
ISSUE. Sheet DoughWeights, Array Cell A4#: Array Rows 453, Table Rows 452, Difference 1. Array longer: SKUs at the end of the spill have no table row and are silently dropped.
